name: Propane dehydrogenation (Oleflex, CATOFIN)
applications: propylene for polypropylene where cracker propylene is short
principle: Propane is heated and passed over a dehydrogenation catalyst, which removes hydrogen to form propylene. The reaction is endothermic and equilibrium-limited, so conversion per pass is partial; unconverted propane is separated and recycled. In UOP's Oleflex process the platinum catalyst is circulated continuously through a regenerator; Lummus CATOFIN uses fixed beds that cycle between reaction and regeneration.

process_steps.name: Dehydrogenation reactors
equipment: Oleflex moving-bed reactors with interheaters, or CATOFIN cyclic fixed beds

process_steps.name: Catalyst regeneration
equipment: continuous catalyst regenerator (Oleflex) / air regeneration cycle (CATOFIN)

performance.basis: Honeywell, as of November 2020; 68 of the last 92 dehydrogenation projects worldwide since 2011 used UOP technology

performance.metric: capacity of each of Oriental Energy's three earlier Oleflex units

reference_plants.name: Oriental Energy, Maoming, Guangdong (fourth Oleflex unit)
reference_plants.capacity: three earlier units of 660,000 t/yr each; capacity of the new unit not stated

limitations: Catalyst regeneration is critical to run length
